programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kenny excelle dans le jeu de carte Magic : l'assemblée ou les combats de coqs font rage dans les milieux underground. Randy, pensant qu'il s'agit de tout autre chose mais se trompe.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Ike ne veut plus jouer avec Kyle à Call of Duty et préfère regarder des personnes jouant et commentant le jeu sur YouTube

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les hologrammes de stars décédées envahissent la télévision : le monde court à la catastrophe dont il ne pourrait jamais se relever.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les garçons expriment tout le respect qu'ils ont pour Caitlyn Jenner dans cette épisode de la série South Park, plus magnifique et courageuse que jamais.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: M. Garrison veut construire un mur pour tenir à distance les immigrants sans papiers.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La ville de South Park entreprend d'importantes rénovations. De son côté, Kenny pense qu'il est temps pour lui de chercher un travail.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman est persuadé d'être le meilleur critique gastronomique du net que South Park ait connu.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman se fait humilier sur les réseaux sociaux à cause de son poids.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les élèves asiatiques de l'école représentent en peinture l'amour imaginaire entre Tweek et Craig.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les habitants de South Park ne veulent plus de policiers dans leur ville.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Jimmy, le rédacteur en chef du journal de l'école, se heurte à l'opinion un peu obtue de Principal PC.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Principal PC disparaît avec deux élèves de CM1.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle mène son combat aux côtés d'une alliée dangereuse au détriment de son amitié avec Stan.
programme.sub-title: Le jugement final de Principal PC

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La poire à lavement devance le sandwich au caca dans la course à la présidence, et cela ne l'arrange pas. J.J. Abrams a pour mission de faire un reboot de l'hymne américain et Kyle veut démasquer le troll qui harcèle les filles de l'école

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le troll chasseauxgarces42 sévit toujours. Les filles sont de plus en plus remontées et menacent les garçons de répliquer si le harcèlement continue. Ceux-ci sont persuadés que Cartman est responsable et ils comptent bien l'arrêter.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Tous deux privés de technologie, Cartman et Heidi se lient d'amitié. La guerre est ouverte entre Freja Ollegard et chasseauxgarces42 qui a peur d'être découvert. M. Garrison fait tout pour ne pas être élu président.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Alors que Kyle soutient les filles, Butters préfère mener la révolte des garçons. Kyle demande l'aide de Cartman, mais ce dernier refuse. L'identité de Gerald a été découverte par un autre troll qui le met en garde face aux Danois.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les trolls s'unissent pour contrecarrer les plans des Danois. Cartman et Heidi encouragent les élèves de l'école à se serrer les coudes, tandis que M. Garrison s'attire la colère de ses sympathisants.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman et Heidi révèlent leur plan à Kyle. Grâce à Heidi, les Danois lancent leur site. Un premier troll est découvert à Fort Collins. Randy et M. Garrison tentent de détruire sans succès les Rappel-baies qui passent alors à l'action.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le pays est sous le choc du résultat des élections. Gerald est envoyé en mission secrète au Danemark par Mme Clinton afin d'utiliser le site anti-trolls contre M. Garrison. Bill Clinton et Bill Cosby font la morale aux élèves de l'école.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les Rappel-baies envahissent la Maison-Blanche. M. Garrison prend ses fonctions mais ne sait pas quoi faire face à l'attaque des Danois. Gerald force Ike à troller à sa place. Cartman et Heidi font la queue pour aller sur Mars.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle convainc les habitants de South Park de demander au président de bombarder le Danemark, mais le regrette très vite. Gerald obtient un entretien avec le soi-disant chasseur de trolls danois. Cartman a peur de perdre Heidi.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman a percé le secret des femmes et veut empêcher les hommes d'aller sur Mars. Gerald affronte le chasseur de trolls en face à face. De son côté, Kyle tente de sauver le monde.
programme.sub-title: Rien ne sera plus jamais comme avant

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Randy découvre ce que cela signifie d'être blanc dans la société d'aujourd'hui.
programme.sub-title: Des blancs qui rénovent des maisons

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La Corée du Nord prend South Park comme cible.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Un lien indéniable se crée entre un homme blanc et un Amérindien.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Facebook est l'arme ultime pour le Professor Chaos.
programme.sub-title: Le prequel du Coon et sa bande

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Des artistes adorés sont fauchés en pleine jeunesse à cause d'énormes overdoses d'opiacés. Stan est sur le point d'être balancé comme dealer de drogue.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Au rassemblement annuel pour Halloween, une sorcière lance un sort qui terrorise tout le monde à South Park.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle joue avec le feu en s'interposant dans la relation de Cartman et Heidi.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: L'expérience de Jimmy et de Timmy pourrait leur rapporter le premier prix à la foire annuelle des sciences.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les temps sont durs pour ceux qui exercent le métier de principal.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les enfants de South Park affirment avoir vu M. Garrison traîner dans le village. Les villageois sont en colère contre le président, qui effraie leurs enfants.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Randy s'acharne à calmer Sharon et Cartman rate son contrôle de maths de façon inattendue.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Butters devient très proche du prêtre de South Park. Un dimanche matin, le prêtre disparaît et l'église est fermée. Les paroissiens décident d'appeler l'archevêque.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: L'attitude agressive de M. Hankey lui vaut la menace d'un renvoi de son poste de directeur du défilé de Noël. Principal PC et la principale adjointe voient leur relation évoluer à un tout autre degré.

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy’s insatiable appetite betrays his true identity, and yet another member of his crew ends up in the brig when two Straw Hats try to fool Commander Jonathan with the same disguise!
programme.sub-title: The marine's dragnet closes in! The second member captured!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Commander Jonathan sets a Straw Hat trap, but Luffy and Sanji are willing to risk it all to help spring their mates. Will a souvenir from the sky save the day – or will their escape plan be scuttled by foul play?
programme.sub-title: Luffy and sanji's daring rescue mission!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and his gang make a break for the docks, and Commander Jonathan deploys armed guards in an attempt to slow down the Straw Hats. Only one thing is certain: somebody is going down for the count!
programme.sub-title: Enter the hot-blooded special forces! Battle on the bridge!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Straw Hats are surrounded, outnumbered, blasted with tear gas. Taking a pretty, young doctor hostage may be their only hope for surviving long enough for a Merry reunion!
programme.sub-title: Breaking through the seige! The going merry is recovered!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and his crew were almost in the clear when Nami made a horrifying discovery: the Marines stole their gold! Now, the Straw Hats must sail straight into the thick of the fight to reclaim their lost riches!
programme.sub-title: The pirate ship disappears! Fortress battle, round #2!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Usopp hatches a plan for a moonlit raid on the Marine vault, but Commander Jonathan is has a nasty surprise waiting for the pirates! Meanwhile, Sanji and Nami attempt to recover the waver.
programme.sub-title: The gold and waver recovery operations!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The extreme arrogance of a Marine special investigator clears a path for Luffy and company to make their escape! Unfortunately, the Straw Hats still have to find their gold before returning to the high seas!
programme.sub-title: The one fell swoop plan! Jonathan's surefire secret tactic!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Straw Hats may think they’re in the clear, but Commander Jonathan has one final trap waiting to ground the Going Merry! If Luffy’s crew is to escape, they’ll need a helping hand – or eight!
programme.sub-title: Farewell, marine fortress! The last battle for escape!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and his mates survive and near-death encounter with some mischievous sea monkeys only to land on a mysterious island where everything is much longer than it should be!
programme.sub-title: Great adventure at long ring long land!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: After a loyal horse and his recently-returned master are assaulted by thugs, Luffy is drawn into a Davy Back Fight with the Foxy Pirates. The Straw Hat captain never backs down from a challenge, but this contest could cost him his crew!
programme.sub-title: A davy back with the foxy pirates!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Davy Back Fight begins with a treacherous Donut Race around Ling Ring Long Land! The Straw Hats square off against the Foxy Pirates in a battle to see who loses a crew member!
programme.sub-title: Round 1! One lap of the donut race!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Nami uses her considerable skill as a navigator to put the Straw Hats on the verge of victory, but the captain of the Foxy Pirates has more than a few dirty tricks up his sleeve!
programme.sub-title: Silver fox foxy! The merciless interference!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Thanks to some foxy sabotage, Chopper has been lost to the enemy. The only hope for getting him back lies with Zoro and Sanji, but can they learn to work together in time to save the little reindeer?
programme.sub-title: Round 2! Shoot it into the groggy ring!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Sanji and Zoro take a beating at the hands of the Groggy Monsters, but they won’t give up the fight. With a little luck – and some teamwork – they’ll emerge victorious from round two of the Davy Back Fight!
programme.sub-title: A barrage of red cards in groggy ring!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Round three of the Davy Back Fight is a rip roaring roller derby! Chopper’s fate still hangs in the balance, and the Straw Hats have a huge problem: Luffy doesn’t know how to skate!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: As the Davy Back Fight sprints toward a sensational finish, the Straw Hats find themselves on the brink of defeat! Luffy’s finally managed to stay on his skates, but the Foxy Pirates are notorious cheaters!
programme.sub-title: A seriously heated race! Into the final round!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Straw Hats somehow manage to defeat the Foxy Pirates and win back Chopper, but Luffy eagerly accepts the challenge of a rematch! What is the captain thinking? And will his crew mutiny?

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: A devious game of dodge ball costs the Straw Hats their archaeologist. Now, they’ll have to win an unusual uphill race to reclaim Robin and avoid losing another crew member!
programme.sub-title: Showdown on the cliff! Red light, green light!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Robin and Chopper have both been lost to the Foxy Pirates, and there’s only one match remaining in the Davy Back Fight! Luffy’s got a plan to get his mates back, but failure would mean the end of the Straw Hats forever!
programme.sub-title: The captains square off! The final combat round!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and Captain Foxy go toe-to-toe in a brutal battle waged aboard a booby-trapped boat. Luffy is fighting for his crew, but Captain Foxy’s dirty tricks have him on the ropes!
programme.sub-title: Full-blast slow-slow onslaught vs. Invulnerable luffy

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy’s epic battle with Captain Foxy reaches its riveting end, and a very old man with a very tall horse reunites with a face from very long ago.
programme.sub-title: Epic, heated combat! The fateful final conclusion

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: When Luffy and his mates lose their memory, Robin is the only Straw Hat who can remember their adventures together. Can she recover their recollections before the crew splits up?
programme.sub-title: Was it lost? Stolen? Who are you?

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Robin tries to hold the crew together while unraveling the mystery of the missing memories. Meanwhile, Nami and Zoro flashback to painful moments from their pasts.
programme.sub-title: A mysterious boy with a horn and robin's deduction!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Straw Hats finally discover the culprit behind their memory loss, but they’ve got bigger problems. The mysterious thief is determined to pit Zoro and Luffy against each other!
programme.sub-title: Now, let's get back our memories! The pirate crew lands on the island!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Zoro and Luffy fight to the death, Nami attempts to orchestrate an uprising, and Sanji discovers he’s willing to kick a kid in order to get his memories back!
programme.sub-title: Zoro bares his fangs! A savage animal stands in the way!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Straw Hats finally regain their memories, but a much larger challenge looms on the horizon. The mysterious thief is about to transform into something even more powerful!
programme.sub-title: The last counterattack by the memory thief who reveals his true colors!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: A terrible storm leads to another run in with the devious Captain Foxy! When Luffy makes the dangerous decision to help his old foe, it could spell disaster for the Straw Hats!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and his mates must survive another outrageous battle aboard Captain Foxy’s booby-trapped boat, and even if they survive, something far worse awaits them!
programme.sub-title: The guy who's the closest to invincible? And the most dangerous man!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Straw Hats take time out to help a group of hungry castaways, but trouble looms on the horizon. An icy marine adversary is out to track down Robin!
programme.sub-title: Navy headquarters admiral aokiji! The ferocity of an ultimate powerhouse!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Chopper and Usopp work feverishly to save Robin from her icy tomb, and Luffy looks to settle the score with Admiral Aokiji in a man-to-man fight to the finish!
programme.sub-title: Duel between rubber and ice! Luffy vs. Aokiji!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: An encounter with a giant swimming frog leads to a close call with a seafaring train! Next up for the Straw Hats: drop anchor at a town full of water and seek out a shipwright!
programme.sub-title: The dashing sea train and the city of water, water seven!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy, Usopp, and Nami take a wild ride through Water Seven in search of a shipwright. Meanwhile, Chopper and Robin get separated during their quest to find a bookstore!
programme.sub-title: Adventure in the city on the water! Head to the mammoth shipbuilding plant!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Zoro is attacked by thugs who want to cash in on his bounty, Sanji gets lost on a grocery shopping expedition, and three suitcases full of cash mysteriously go missing!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: A carpenter and his talking pigeon help recover the Straw Hats’ missing money, but the Franky Family won’t give up so easily. Luffy and Nami receive very bad news about their beloved boat!
programme.sub-title: Galley-la company! A grand sight: dock #1!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and Nami refuse to believe that the Going Merry’s seaworthy days are finished, but for now, bigger problems loom on the horizon! Their money is missing again, along with Usopp!
programme.sub-title: Pirate abduction incident! A pirate ship that can only await her end!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Happy Best Friends Day! Today's a special day for best friends to play together. Boots and Dora decide to meet for a picnic to celebrate. Boots is bringing chocolate; Dora is bringing yummy strawberries.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: A is for armadillo, but where are the rest of the animals in the ABC book? They're missing! Dora and Boots jump into the giant alphabet book to help the little armadillo solve the mystery.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: What do you want to be when you grow up? On today's adventure, Dora and Boots get to try all sorts of jobs - from a pilot to a chef to an archeologist. But what will Dora decide to be when she grows up?

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Excited, Dora puts the Star Pocket on Backpack and Dora and Boots set off on their very first star catching adventure. Their educational journey will take them all the way to the Cloud Castle, as they try to rescue an adorable baby star.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora tells the story of how she first met Boots. On their very first adventure, Dora and Boots have to bring instruments back to the Fiesta Trio so they can play for the cranky Queen Bee.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Swiper swipes Dora's favorite necklace and flings it all the way to the top of Star Mountain! To get to the peak, Dora and Boots need to run up the Star Steps, climb up the Diamond, and make it through ice, wind, and snow!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: "Hola, hola!/ Hello, Hello!/ It's a great day for school/ You know!" Boots' music teacher, la maestra de música, needs to get to school in a hurry - but her bicycle is broken!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: It's Dora's cousin Daisy's 15th birthday party, her quinceañera! But the party can't start without Dora and Boots - they need to teach everybody the mambo!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's cousin Diego protects and defends all the animals in the rainforest. But in order to save a Baby Condor, Diego winds up trapped himself. And now he needs OUR help! ¡No te preocupes, Diego!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Oh no! Baby Jaguar's best friend, Baby Bear, is stuck on a ledge atop Bear Mountain - and the ledge is cracking! With Baby Jaguar leading the way, Dora, Boots, and Diego race to the rescue!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots set out to help King Juan el Bobo find his crown so we can all go to his Mamí's birthday party. Where did the forgetful king put his crown?

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Abuela gives Dora and Boots a present for Dora's new puppy, but they'll have to watch out for Swiper, who's got a bunch of new swiping tricks up his sleeves.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora has some really exciting news to tell us: Someone new is joining Dora's family! Someone who sleeps in a cradle, drinks from a bottle, wears diapers and likes to be rocked to sleep. Can you guess who it is? That's right!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Oh, no! Dora left her music homework in Boots' room. It's a song in English and Spanish, and she needs Boots to bring it to her school so she can sing it to the class.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's baby brother and sister just love bananas, but they also love stories! So Dora tells them a Super Babies story! The Super Babies have to get their bananas back from that Super Villain Swiper the Fox.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and all her friends are at the Super Adventure Race! To win the race, they have to make it across the Troll's tricky Bridge, past the Volcano filled with gooey balls, over the giant wall, and all the way to the finish line.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: It's summertime, and Dora and Boots are having a blast at the beach. But suddenly, they encounter the strangest sight - a snowman in Summer? What's wrong with this picture? Oh, no!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots are hiking on Rainbow Rock when they come across a shy rainbow, Arco Iris, hiding behind a waterfall.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots are having a blast at the beach when all of a sudden they hear a call for help. It's a baby crab stuck in a net!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots are playing catch when they discover a lost Baby Fox. And he wants his mommy! Just then, Swiper shows up to swipe Boots' superball.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's twin brother and sister have been sick and she wants to buy them a present to cheer them up. Way up on a toy store shelf, she finds a dusty Jack-in-the-Box.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: It's Twins Day and everyone's getting ready for the big Twins Day Party at Play Park! Dora even has a surprise for her puppy Perrito. He has a twin too -- a long-lost puppy brother he hasn't seen since they were babies.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: "Happy Three Kings Day!" Dora, Boots, and Diego are dressed up as kings for the big Three Kings Day party. They'll be bringing a horse, a camel, and an elephant to carry the presents, and treats for the party, but Swiper scares the animals away!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Isa are planting Isa's special unicorn flowers when suddenly a baby unicorn, Unicornio, rides in on a Rainbow. He's thrilled to see Isa's beautiful flowers because they're his Mami's favorite.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Benny is so excited – it's his first time in the Big Go-Cart Race, where everyone races in homemade go-carts! But when the whistle blows, Benny's cart backfires and falls to pieces. But Dora and Boots won't let him give up.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Boots and Tico are really excited because it's their first day of school ever -- and in their new school, they'll learn in English and Spanish!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Backpack, Backpack, yeah!!! Today's the Backpack Parade, where everyone dresses up their backpacks in different costumes. Backpack is super excited 'cause this year she gets to lead the parade with her song.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: "Special delivery for Boots the monkey!" Boots' favorite boots are back from the Shoe Shop, but when he tries them on, he starts to bounce, bounce, bounce. These aren't his boots -- these are bouncy boots.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora reads us a Mayan story about twin brothers who were amazing ballplayers. A long time ago in a Mayan Kingdom, there was a big Ball Game Championship.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots are reading their favorite story, "The Three Little Pigs" when suddenly we hear the Piggies calling out for help. Their brick house is missing some bricks and the Big Bad Wolf is going to blow it down!
programme.sub-title: Dora Saves the Three Little Piggies

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: ABRACADABRA! The Big Red Chicken's putting on a magic show for all of his friends. With an "abracadabra," he pulls a rabbit out of his hat, but when it's time to make the bunny disappear, it doesn't work!
programme.sub-title: The Big Red Chicken's Magic Show

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: It's Junk Day and Benny's showing Dora and Boots his wagon of cool junk. But when the junk truck accidentally takes Backpack and Map off to the junkyard, it's up to Dora, Boots, Benny and his wagon of stuff to rescue them!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: It's naptime for the twins and Dora has a special Super Babies naptime story. Once upon a time, the Super Babies were getting ready for their nap but the Dream Fairy never showed up because she was still asleep!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Pirate Piggy really wants to be in the big Pirate Treasure Hunt, but his Piggies got tummyaches. He needs at least 3 mates to help him find the sunken treasure. Dora, Boots, and L'il Piggy will be his pirate mates -- yay!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora reads a story about a Wizzle who could grant wishes with his magic wand. On his birthday, it's his turn to make a wish but the wand gets blown away by the wind. Dora needs your help to save the Wizzle's magic wand!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Enter the Dragons: Part 2: The final showdown! With the help of allies and enemies alike, the Turtles have fought their way through a demonic version of New York to confront the Shredder once and for all!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Future Shellshock!: The Turtles and Splinter suddenly find themselves in a futuristic world of flying cars, multiple atmospheric and gravity zones and a "melting pot" population of humans and aliens. Who's responsible for this mess?

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Obsolete: Hoping to fix the Time Window and return home, the Turtles sneak out with Cody and go to O'Neil Tech. However, Darius sees the guys and wants them away from Cody and in his lab for study!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Home Invasion: Raphael is impatient with the highly automated future - especially when Cody builds the Turtles a fancy new Dojo complete with realistic holographic simulation battle programs.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Headlock Prime: When he sees an ad for a pro-wrestling tournament, a homesick Raph can't resist. But the evening of fun is spoiled when TRIPLE THREAT, a banned wrestler with three bickering heads, crashes the arena.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Playtime's Over: Mikey, obsessed with the video game HELIX goes crackers when he finds out that the sequel is being released. The turtles need a guide to navigate the humongous LEVELLEX MALL, and enlist clueless Cody, who enlists street-wise Starlee.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Bishop to Knight: The guys are shocked to find that their old archenemy, Agent Bishop, is alive and well in the year 2105. And worse, he's President of the Pan-Galactic Council?!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Night of Sh'Okanabo: When Mikey finds out that Cody has never seen a horror flick, our boisterous movie aficionado drags Cody and his three brothers downtown for a little horror movie festival viewing.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Clash of the Turtle Titans: Mikey is shocked to discover someone has taken over his old super hero persona TURTLE TITAN. Insane with jealousy, Mikey tries to put the kibosh on the 22nd century imposter.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Fly Me to the Moon: Cody and the Turtles go to the moon in search of a rare lunar alloy. But their quest is cut short when they discover that the Inuwashi Gunjin have been sent there by Darius Dun to make sure that they never come back alive.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Invasion of the Body Jacker: Jammerhead takes identity theft to whole new level when he gets his hands on the ultimate stealth device—The Bodyjacker! He uses it to take over Darius Dun's body!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Freaks Come Out at Night: After an outing downtown, Mikey starts behaving strangely -- as in super strength, green-slime-spewing strangely. The reason, the Turtles soon discover, is that Mikey has been "implanted" by one of Sh'Okanabo's "gene-seeds".

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Bad Blood: There are some new terrapins in town - the Dark Turtles: the psychotic clones of the original TMNT. They can match the boys kick for kick (or in Mikey's case, quip for quip).

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Journal: While rooting around in Cody's Trophy Room, Don, Leo, Mike and Raph come across the old "future history" journal kept by April O'Neil and Casey Jones.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Gaminator: The Turtles get their hands on a prototype game system called "The Gaminator," rumored to be the ultimate gaming experience. They get more than they bargained for when they are digitized and sucked into the game.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Graduation Day: Class of 2105: Splinter is pleased to announce that the Turtles are about to graduate from the ninja rank of Genin to the more advanced rank of Chunin.Everyone is excited until it is made clear that Michelangelo will not be graduating!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Timing is Everything: When Darius Dun and Sh'Okanabo join forces, it can only mean one thing—trouble! Anxious to test out their version of Cody's Time Window, Sh'Okanabo jumps the gun and unleashes a "Time storm" on NYC!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Enter the Jammerhead: Jammerhead busts his way out of prison, looking to even the score with his Turtle Nemeses. Thanks to a newly developed chip, he can download fighter footage) and instantly mimic the moves.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Milk Run: Intergalactic mercenary TORBIN ZIIXX returns and enlists the Turtles' help in smuggling a ship full of humanitarian aid past TRICERATON GANGSTERS. But the Triceratons are obsessed with finding Ziixx.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Fall of Darius Dunn: When Cody uncovers Darius Dunn's secret weapons manufacturing program, he and his uncle have a final showdown over who will ultimately control the vast O'Neil tech empire.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Turtle X-Tinction: Turtle X is on the rampage throughout New Manhattan - but Cody insists he has nothing to do with it. It turns out the fugitive Darius Dun planted a "Trojan Horse" virus in Cody's exo-armor and is now controlling Turtle X.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Race for Glory: The Turtles enter a tricked-out Hovershell in a cross-country road race that pits the latest high tech experimental vehicles against one another.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Head of State: When President Bishop is attacked by mysterious underground monsters, he enlists the help of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles. Our fearless green guardians must rescue Bishop before he loses his head to a figure from the Turtles' past.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: DNA is Thicker than Water: Darius comes down hard on the Darks and places the blame squarely on Dark Leo's spiky shoulders. To prove that he is an apt leader Dark Leo devises a plan to destroy the Turtles from within.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Cosmic Completist: Raphael has contempt for Michelangelo's geeky toy collection, but when the leader of the Inawashi Gunjin comes to the Turtles for help with a malevolent alien, Raphael must think like a geek to beat Aramzedo, the ultimate collector!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Day of Awakening: When the entire population of Moonbase Bishop goes missing, it appears that Sh'Okanabo has jump started his plan to take over the Earth.The Turtles stage an assault on the base, only to find a bigger, badder Sh'Okanabo!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Zixxth Sense: Torbin Zixx convinces the Turtles to help him recover an experimental matter transmitter that he was forced to give to Boss Zukko to pay off a debt. The fate of the world may rest on the success of their mission. But can they trust Zixx?

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Tempus Fugit: When the Time Window is finally repaired, the Turtles enter into it to head home, but instead of finding themselves back in the lair, our heroes find themselves with Viral!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Karate Schooled: When the turtles are reunited with Casey and April, it's smiles all around … until it becomes clear that Casey's being brainwashed by his new martial arts instructor, Master Khan, a devoted Foot operative.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Something Wicked: The turtles' journey into cyberspace as Cybernauts on a mission to save as much of Master Splinter as they can find. But, they find far more than they're ready for. The Shredder! Born again. Inside the digital realm.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Engagement Ring: Casey and Raph head to Chinatown to find an engagement ring for April. They find one, all right. Too bad it has dark, transformational powers. Powers that are of interest to Hun and the Purple Dragons as well…

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Hacking Stockman: While Don focuses on collecting Splinter's data bits, his brothers find themselves pulled into a war between The Foot and the Purple Dragons. But things get a lot worse when the cyber-Shredder finds a way out of the digital realm!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Incredible Shrinking Serling: Desperate to get back to his own time, Serling builds a makeshift Time Window for himself. But when he's zapped to the NYC sewers to Turtle Tot time it's his worst nightmare as they tap him as their favorite new toy.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Identity Crisis: Cyber Shredder unleashes a virus that wipes the turtles memories out... reprogramming them so that they work for the Foot! The turtles do the bidding of Master Khan while April, Casey and Serling must work together to save our heroes.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Web Wranglers: When the Cyber Shredder creates a web portal that will allow him to venture from cyberspace into the real world, he first tests the device by releasing all sorts of mutants and monsters from various online programs.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: SuperQuest: The good news is the Turtles have found more of Splinter's lost data bits! The bad news is they're imbedded within the interface of Mikey's favorite online video game, SuperQuest!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Virtual Reality Check: The turtles leave Cyberspace to find everything very … normal. But, as this normalcy starts to unravel, the turtles realize they're still in Cyberspace, and the Shredder is tricking them.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Une bombe de mutagène a ravagé la Terre. Dans ce futur post-apocalyptique, Raph et Donnie affrontent le Clan des Blaireaux Maraudeurs du Bitume.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Dans un futur post-apocalyptique, Donnie le robot, Raph et Mira partent à la recherche du Grand Booyakasha qui peut déchiffrer la carte qui mène à Oasis.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Raph met le cap sur Oasis, poursuivi par Maximus Kong. Le combat s'engage.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'apparition des tortues, 1ère partie
programme.desc: Splinter autorise enfin les tortues à remonter à la surface. Elles tentent de secourir une jeune fille mais s'aperçoivent qu'elles ne savent pas se battre en équipe.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'apparition des tortues, 2e partie
programme.desc: Les tortues apprennent qu'April et son père sont retenus prisonniers par les Krangs, de méchants extraterrestres déguisés en robots androïdes. Les tortues réussiront-elles à pénétrer dans le repaire de l'ennemi et à combattre en équipe ?

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Caractère de tortue
programme.desc: Raphael perd son sang-froid quand un vieux New-Yorkais fait une vidéo des Tortues Ninja en train de se battre contre les Krangs. Les tortues doivent mettre la main sur cette vidéo avant qu'elles ne tombent entre de mauvaises mains.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Nouvel ami, vieil ennemi
programme.desc: Pour prouver que les tortues ninja peuvent se lier d'amitié avec des humains, Michelangelo se fait un ami sur un réseau social. Mais cet ami est-il digne de confiance ?

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Je crois qu'il s'appelle Baxter Stockman
programme.desc: Lorsque les tortues quittent le repaire contre l'avis de Splinter, elles font la rencontre de Baxter Stockman, un inventeur dérangé vêtu d'une armure de combat.
programme.sub-title: Je crois qu'il s'appelle Baxter Stockman

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Malin comme un singe
programme.desc: En enquêtant sur la disparition d'un scientifique, Donatello et April croisent la route d'un singe au comportement bizarre et découvrent un complot.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Xever la menace
programme.desc: Léo pourrait regretter d'avoir fait preuve de clémence, quand Xever prend en otage le propriétaire d'un restaurant de nouilles chinoises.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le défi
programme.desc: April reçoit un message alarmant de la part de son père prisonnier. Les tortues et elles partent en mission pour le sauver et empêcher les Krangs de faire exploser une bombe de mutagène en pleine ville.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Panique dans les égoûts
programme.desc: Les tortues sont obligées de défendre leur repaire dans les égoûts que Bradford veut détruire à l'aide d'un dangereux produit chimique.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'attaque des Mascottes !
programme.desc: Des menaces multiples forcent les tortues à se séparer en deux groupes. Donnie et Mikey doivent prouver que leur équipe de remplaçants a autant de valeur que l'équipe des champions composée par Léo et Raph.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La créature venue des profondeurs
programme.desc: Michelangelo devient ami avec un alligator mutant déséquilibré qui est en possession d'un étrange outil de technologie appartenant aux Krangs. Mais est-il digne de confiance ?

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Une fille mystérieuse
programme.desc: Las d'entendre les critiques de Raph, Léo laisse son frère diriger l'équipe. Pendant ce temps, Léo rencontre une belle et dangereuse kunoïchi.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le Roi des Rats
programme.desc: Les tortues doivent faire face à nouvel ennemi, le Roi des Rats, qui menace de prendre le contrôle de la ville, mais aussi de l'esprit de Splinter.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le plan des Krangs
programme.desc: Quand les devoirs d'école d'April attirent l'attention des Krangs, les tortues prennent le lycée d'assaut.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le Pulvériseur
programme.desc: Les tortues ont un problème avec le Pulvériseur, un adolescent qui se prend pour un héros et qui veut combattre le crime à leurs côtés.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Mystère au TCRI
programme.desc: En s'introduisant dans l'enceinte très surveillée du TCRI, les tortues découvrent les véritables intentions des Krangs.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le cafard Terminator
programme.desc: Alors qu'elles tentent de déjouer le plan d'invasion de la Terre par les Krangs, les tortues sont pourchassées par un cafard géant et indestructible.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le labyrinthe de la peur
programme.desc: Fatigué d'être humilié par Fishface et Dogpound, et de perdre face aux tortues, Baxter Stockman prépare sa vengeance.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'ennemi de mon ennemi
programme.desc: Après avoir vu les Krangs à l'œuvre, Karai propose une alliance aux tortues. Mais est-elle digne de confiance ?

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La mission de Karaï
programme.desc: Le clan des Foot tente de capturer April, qui doit combattre Karaï si elle veut leur échapper.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le retour du Pulvériseur
programme.desc: Quand Shredder projette de créer une armée de mutants, les tortues demandent l'aide de leur plus grand fan.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'œuf
programme.desc: Leonardo, Raphael et Donatello deviennent les esclaves d'une guêpe mutante. Leur sort dépend de leur frère Michelangelo.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Une évasion à haut risque
programme.desc: April reçoit un message codé. Pendant que ses frères dorment, Donatello tente de le déchiffrer. C'est Kirby O'Neil, le père d'April, qui appelle à l'aide...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'affrontement, 1ère partie
programme.desc: Les Krangs s'apprêtent à lancer la phase finale de l'invasion de la Terre. Ils préparent l'arrivée du Technodrome depuis la dimension X, qui se fera par le portail.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'affrontement, 2e partie
programme.desc: Leonardo a survécu à l'explosion du dernier étage du TCRI, mais n'a pu empêcher le passage du Technodrome par le portail. L'immense vaisseau en forme de sphère sème la terreur sur la ville, en tirant à vue et enlevant des humains...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Mutation accidentelle
programme.desc: C'est la fête chez les Tortues Ninja, mais malheureusement, ça ne va pas durer longtemps ! Les tortues ont répandu accidentellement une cargaison de tubes de mutagène au-dessus de la ville.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Qui est le chef ?
programme.desc: Les tortues parcourent la ville à la recherche des tubes de mutagène grâce au détecteur de fluides de Donnie. Karai repère leur manège et décide de leur tendre un piège...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'invasion des écureuils-mutants
programme.desc: Tandis qu'elles parcourent la ville à la recherche de tubes de mutagène, les tortues tombent sur un sans-abri au comportement étrange. Il est aux prises avec un écureuil très agressif, qui finit par se faufiler dans son estomac...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Mutagène-man se déchaîne
programme.desc: Pendant que ses frères regardent un dessin animé débile sur une vieille cassette vidéo, Donatello se confie à Timothy, transformé en mutant et conservé dans un tube dans son labo.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'acné mutante de Mikey

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Une cible nommée April O'Neil
programme.desc: Shredder a eu vent du comportement de Karaï durant son absence et lui ordonne de ne plus s'allier aux Krangs. Mais ces derniers ont fabriqué le successeur des Foot-bots, et Karaï veut absolument se le procurer afin d'éliminer April...

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: When two Croc Bandits have a spat, it's up to Po and Mr. Ping to set things right.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: In an attempt to get out of training, Po buys some enchanted shoes that will heighten his kung fu abilities. Unfortunately for Po, the magical shoes are evil and will soon put him and all those around him in great danger.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po is embarrassed when his dad takes him on a wild goose chase, but it turns out his dad is not so crazy afterall.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: When Master Mugan from the Garnet Palace decides she needs a new Kung Fu Master, Tigress volunteers. Will the Furious Five be minus one or will Po convince Tigress to return to the Jade Palace?

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: When Po's friend Peng returns to the Valley of Peace, everyone is excited...except for Po. What no one else knows is that Peng is actually evil Tai Lung's nephew. Now Po has to admit to powerful Peng that he is the one who skadooshed his uncle.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: As the annual Winter Festival approaches, Po doesn't have enough money to buy his dad the present he deserves, so he takes a job as a bounty hunter to capture a dangerous escaped convict for the reward. But Po's plan doesn't go as smooth as he hoped.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po takes on the challenge of training a lovable but klutzy member of the Emperor's family. However, will Po's training be enough to protect them both from the evil designs of a traitor in their midst?

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: After dealing Taotie yet another humiliating defeat, Po is horrified to learn that the villainous warthog has had a full on nervous breakdown. Po is determined to heal his spirit and Taotie is eager to change his evil ways...or is he?

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: When Po's fake love letter prank on Monkey backfires, the duo's relationship is put to the test in a story of jealousy, betrayal and, yes, even kidnapping.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po is sad when he learns that everyone has been invited to a dinner party except for him, due to his poor table manners. Will Shifu be able to teach Po proper etiquette AND foil the attack of evil Temutai and his army?

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: When Shifu's ex-girlfriend, Mei Ling, visits the Jade Palace, Po decides to try and get them back together, despite the fact Mei Ling is now Shifu's most hated enemy.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po and Tigress must track down and stop a messenger from delivering a scroll that could thrust China into all-out war!

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po and the Furious Five meet their greatest challenge yet: a supernatural creature who is invincible to the powers of kung fu.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po and the Furious Five meet their greatest challenge yet: a supernatural creature who is invincible to the powers of kung fu.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Crane's mom visits the Valley of Peace. Crane reveals to Po that his mom hates Kung Fu so he promised her that he would never have anything to do with it. Crane asks Po and the others to help him keep his secret from his mom.
programme.sub-title: Mama Told Me not to Kung Fu

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Self-conscious about his size, Mantis ingests a growth potion that makes him huge. Mantis is initially thrilled with the results, but soon his large size puts the entire village and his friends in grave danger.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: With Po and the Furious Five at each other's throats, Shifu takes them all on a disastrous road trip.
programme.sub-title: The Secret Museum of Kung Fu

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Fung finds an old scroll with instructions for making living terra cotta warriors, and soon it's up to Po and the Five to stop his monstrous clay creation.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: When Po is possessed by the ghost of evil Master Ding, it's up to Tigress to save him before Ding can unleash his powers and enslave the Valley of Peace.
programme.sub-title: The Spirit Orbs of Master Ding

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Master Chao visits the valley to oversee a Tournament. Shifu is convinced that Po and Master Chao want to replace him. Shifu's old enemy, Pai Mei, arrives in the middle of the tournament and threatens to destroy Shifu.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Master Yao returns to the Jade Palace and announces that he's offering the Valley of Peace a one-day "Wonder and Wisdom Exchange." Anyone who brings him a new wonder will be allowed to ask him a single question.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po saves a girl from some bandits, only to learn that she's engaged to be married to the Dragon Warrior

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: During a fight with Tong Fo, Po is struck by lightning, giving him the power to read minds.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Thanks to Po, Hundun opens up his own noodle shop in the village, threatening to put Mr. Ping out of business.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Over Po's objections, Shifu calls in a noble Samurai prawn to help take down a villain from Japan.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Shifu suggests Po takes a vow of silence to help him focus, but his plan goes awry when the panda starts an armed conflict by keeping his mouth shut.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Once deemed a hero, cobra Fu-xi has turned renegade and is attacking the Valley of Peace. When the villagers adopt an anti-snake sentiment, will Viper help stop Fu-xi...or join him?

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: The local thugs love Mr. Ping's soup so much, the noodle shop becomes a villain hangout...with Mr. Ping as their unknowing crime boss!

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po befriends a group of young (and adorable) orphans-who also happen to be stealing money and goods from the villagers. Will Po be able to reform the kids or fall into the clutches of their evil leader?

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Fed up with his constant complaining, Shifu puts lazy Po in charge of training the Furious Five. Things go from bad to worse when the Croc Bandits receive training from a mysterious kung fu master and become the new heroes of the Valley of Peace.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po is named Head of Imperial Security when klutzy Lu Kang returns to the Valley of Peace as emperor. When an evil menace rises to take over all of China, Po has to turn to some surprising allies in order to save the day.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Child abductions are a reality, & friends, neighbors & even relatives can kidnap your youngster. Two victims share heart-wrenching stories of abduction & how they were returned to their families. Find out what you need to know to keep your child safe!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil's guests engage in a heated debate about the rights of men and women when a child is conceived out of wedlock. Should the biological father be forced to pay child support for a child he didn't know existed or did not plan?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: With Nancy Grace, children's rights attorney Paul Mones & criminologist Dr. Denise Boots, Dr. Phil delves into the headlines: a starved & beaten teen escaping his torturers, an 8-year-old boy arrested for killing his father & two reporters found dead.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Are you newlyweds suffering Honeymoon Hangover? The Bahamas vacation is over, the dress is put away and couples realize they now have this to face: Married Life. Dr. Phil discovers how little couples know about each other before they walk down the aisle.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What happens when an unhealthy relationship threatens to tear a mother and daughter apart? Giesel says her 18-year-old daughter is boyfriend-obsessed and is damaging her promising future. Watch drama unfold as a pregnancy scare rocks this teen's life.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Teens are obsessed with love more than ever. Parents are concerned over measures their daughters take to keep a boyfriend. A poll asked teens about extreme behavior, some saying they had sex when the didn't want to. Parents, don't miss these safety steps.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: It’s an emotional story that has captivated viewers for years. John Clark’s search for his three children abducted by their mother concludes when John received news that his children were found and living in London. John reunites with his children. Part 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In a gripping two-part series, Dr. Phil sits down with a family torn apart over accusations of the unthinkable. Melody says her 4-year-old granddaughter revealed that she was touched inappropriately by a man in a mask, and that the man was her daddy.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil goes into his mailbag to answer viewers' popular questions! He has help from commedienne and author Teresa Strasser. When Teresa talks to moms on the street, find out their biggest parenting and pregnancy queries. Update on Ted Williams.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil’s guests say the green-eyed monster has affected their marriage. Paula claims loyalty and Mike questions her fidelity. Mike placed listening devices in the home, set up surveillance cameras to follow her, and subjected Paula to polygraph tests.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Melanie says her 19-year-old daughter's boyfriend, Michael, is a drug-abusing gangbanger. What would cause her to have such a negative opinion of him? Learn why Michael initially agrees to a drug test, and then refuses. Will he break down and take it?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A sleepy Indiana town awoke one winter morning in 1992 to news the lifeless body of 12-year-old Shanda Sharer was discovered in an open field. She had been stabbed, strangled, beaten, and burned alive. Who committed this vicious and heinous crime? Part 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Families are devastated when children go missing, but oftentimes it is a parental abduction. Fifteen years ago, John Clark came home from work to find his wife and three children gone, leaving only a cryptic note saying they went on vacation. Part 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Many women are itching to run to the altar, but Dr. Phil's guests say they are ready to run for the hills! Meet Kelly, who calls herself a runaway bride, and Chad, who says weddings are too expensive. Can Dr. Phil get them to commit?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Horrific allegations are tearing a family apart. Todd, ex girlfriend Latia & mom Diana tell their versions of sexual misconduct. Todd says he will do anything to prove his innocence. Dr. Phil calls in a polygraph examiner, with shocking results.
programme.sub-title: A Father Accused: Who's Telling The Truth?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tracey says her 23-year marriage is falling apart because husband Doug is having an affair with transgender female Essence. Tracey wants Doug to choose once and for all so that she can move on with her life. Why is she leaving the decision to him?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Quinn says his wife, Sara, smashed a glass door, putting several stitches in his head, and punched, slapped, and kicked him in the face. But why won't he leave her? Can Dr. Phil help mend this fractured family as he confronts Sara about the alleged abuse?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Rheta says she wants her husband, Mark, to cut the cord with his meddling mother, Deb, who has created an online dating profile for him, paid for divorce lawyers and tried to set him up with his ex-girlfriend! Dr. Phil looks at this troubled union. Part 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: This 2004 YouTube viral video sent shock waves, racked up millions of views, and stirred online outrage. Texas Judge William Adams is lashing his then 16-year-old daughter with a belt, despite her pleas to stop. Do you think Adam's actions are justified?
programme.sub-title: Discipline Video: A Daughter's New Accusations Against The Judge

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Stacy and her boyfriend are accused of burning her 3-year-old daughter with cigarettes. What will lie detector tests reveal? Plus, Christina's mother has called CPS on her four times for allegedly abusing her grandson. Are Christina's kids in danger?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Many were stunned and outraged when Casey Anthony was acquitted of murder charges in her daughter Caylee's death. Lead prosecutor Jeff Ashton joins Dr. Phil to answer some hard-hitting questions about where his case went wrong.
